recursive_update: recursively update a nested dictionary with values from another dictionary
iterate_flattened: iterate over a nested dictionary yielding dotted paths and leaf values
set_by_dotted_path: set a value in a nested dictionary using a dotted path string
get_by_dotted_path: get a value from a nested dictionary using a dotted path string
convert_camel_case_to_snake_case: convert a CamelCase string to snake_case format
